title: Dataset
description: A dataset, or collection of datasets, curated for publication and the role held in curating it. Each record is one JSON file under datasets/.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, so editors can validate and autocomplete the record.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema that the record follows.

name.description: Title of the dataset or collection.

group.description: Research group that produced the data, e.g. "Leifer Lab".

institution.description: Institution the group belongs to, e.g. "Princeton University". Omitted for groups that span several institutions.

role.description: Role held in curating the data, e.g. "Primary Engineer" or "Supervisor".

manuscript.description: The associated publication, ideally as a DOI link.

dataset.description: The published data, e.g. a Dandiset on the DANDI Archive.

notebook.description: Jupyter Notebook(s) demonstrating how to access and analyze the data.

code.description: Source code that converted the data to a standard format.

description.description: Paragraphs of plain text describing the curation work. **Double asterisks** mark emphasis.
